references.summary: volumedetect measures mean signal level in dBFS. The numerical difference between a reference and a processed signal can reveal level loss; unexpected large differences warrant technical investigation.

silencedetect reports continuous below-threshold signal intervals. A sustained silent segment in an output but not its reference can indicate a missing signal path, mute or dropout; human context remains necessary.

PCM16 saturation counts samples reaching integer full scale. A high saturated-sample ratio in processed audio compared with a clean reference indicates flat-topped quantization clipping, but it does not establish artistic mastering quality.
